turns.replyText:
My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If your tracking shows delivered but you don’t have the package, One Fast Cat’s guidance is:



First, check around your property and with neighbors.


FedEx may sometimes mark a package delivered early, so allow 24 hours after the delivery scan.


If it still hasn’t arrived after 24 hours, contact One Fast Cat so they can start a carrier trace.


The trace takes about 2 business days.


You must contact them within 5 days of the delivery scan to start the trace.


If the carrier cannot recover and redeliver the package in time, their policy says they can offer a one-time replacement.


Their published policy says they do not issue refunds for orders that show as delivered.



Details are published here: https://onefastcat.com/pages/delivery

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?

created: One Fast Cat can update the shipping address.

pensate for a long delay?

- Expedited shipping fees are not refundable if delivery is late
- Shipping time estimates are estimates, not guarantees
